summary: The filing reports Mitesco, Inc.'s entry into a Common Stock Purchase Agreement and a Registration Rights Agreement with an institutional investor, committing up to $30 million in equity purchases. The company issued a $600,000 convertible promissory note as commitment consideration. Sales are at the company's option, at a discount to VWAP, with a $250,000 per-purchase cap. The arrangement is an at-the-market equity facility, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring. It is routine financing with no change of control or strategic event. Watch for dilution from future draws and SEC registration effectiveness.
